summary: The documents pertain to the OccHealth page of the HSPnet system, focusing on student enrollment health requirements management.
purpose: To manage and display occupational health requirements for student enrollments, including interface controls and data validations.
business_rules: Hide Save All buttons if less than 14 rows.
Disable edit fields if read-only mode is enabled.
validations: Ensure UserSession is active before operations.
calculations: Determine if rows should be visible based on user session and access.
conditions: Row is editable if not read-only and all access checks pass.
Disable controls if information is waived or the user lacks access.
system_behavior: Sort gridData based on specified parameters.
Update interface based on read-only flag and data bindings.
dependencies: UserSession must be intact for interactions.
System configuration and state determine available interactions.
exceptions: Cancel operations if UserSession is null.
Error handling for database operations should be in place.
